3 10-07-2025 Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The appellant has been held guilty and convicted for the offences under section 376 of the I.P.C.
and has been directed to sentence to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and the fine of Rs.
10,000/-and in default of payment of fine the appellant shall further undergo an imprisonment of 06 month under the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 21.05.2024 and 29.05.2024 passed in Session Trial No. 53 of 2022/ CIS Registration No. 53 of 2022 (arising out of Madhubani Mahila P.S. Case No. 81 of 2021) by Sri Syed Md. Fazlul Bari, the learned court of lat Addl. Sessions Judge, Madhubani.
3. According to the FIR, the victim was residing in the house of her sister where she was performing the work of Patna High Court CR.

entities.text: Session Trial No. 53 of 2022/ CIS Registration No. 53 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
. In course of working, she met with the appellant, who on the false pretext of marriage, committed rape upon her,
as a result of which, the victim became pregnant and later on, the appellant refused to marry with her.

4. While making the prayer to suspend the sentence and grant of bail, it has been submitted on behalf of the appellant that at the time of alleged occurrence, the victim was major and she was aware of the fact that wife of the appellant had died.
In her statement recorded under Section-164 of the Cr.P.C., the victim has stated that she went with the appellant with her own sweet will.

6. Learned APP has opposed the prayer for bail.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, presently I am not inclined to suspend the sentence and grant bail to the appellant and accordingly, the same is rejected.
8. However, if so advised, the appellant may renew his prayer for bail after one year.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) A.K.V.//-
